thread:
Anya: Heads-up — ACME SI + EdgeHW garage partner want to list in the marketplace next month. Need a quick intake plan for SOC reports, pen-test artifacts, and the integration questionnaire. Who owns the pieces? :eyes:
Jorge: I can own pen-test evidence + vuln scan exports. Timeline?
Anya: Target listing 2026-04-15, so we need consolidated artifacts by 2026-03-31. Pen-test ideally completed by first week of April or earlier.
Samira: Legal will take questionnaire review and attestation statements. @Ken please confirm upload flow and who is the manifest owner.
Ken: Partner-ops for uploads. I need presigned S3 links + a CSV manifest mapping artifact -> owner -> retention. Can we standardize filenames?
Anya: Proposed naming convention: <partner>-<artifact>-<version>-<env>.pdf (lowercase, dashes).
Ken: Works for me. Also need contact_email and retention_days in manifest.
Jorge: Pen-test deliverables we need from vendor/SI: redacted full report, executive summary, remediation timeline (CSV), vuln scan exports (nessus/qualys), patch matrix, and scope doc.
Samira: I'll prepare an attestation template and a short shared-responsibility statement (infra vs app). Also require network diagrams if EdgeHW has hardware-in-the-loop.
Anya: SOC2 items: cover letter, SOC2 Type II redacted, and an evidence index that maps controls to artifacts and timestamps.
Ken: For marketplace upload we'll use a CSV manifest with columns: partner,artifact_key,owner,contact_email,retention_days,presign_expiry. Example manifest row:
```
partner,artifact_key,owner,contact_email,retention_days,presign_expiry
acme,acme-soc2-type2-2025.pdf,jorge@redwood.com,security@acme.com,365,72h
```
Ken: I'll wire up a small job to generate presigned links once the manifest is confirmed.
Ops-bot: Reminder: compliance ticket CF-245 created for ACME listing. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CF-245
Jorge: Quick question on scope: do we require pen-test to include hardware network segmentation evidence for EdgeHW?
Samira: Yes. Request network diagrams, segmentation rules, and an attacker-surface writeup. Also ask the SI to provide their SOC evidence if they process customer data.
Anya: Action items recap: Jorge -> collect pen-test artifacts and scan exports (due 2026-03-28). Samira -> draft attestation + questionnaire answers (due 2026-03-25). Ken -> manifest template + presign automation (due 2026-03-22). I'll coordinate final upload and review.
Ken: Acknowledged. I'll also produce a short checklist doc and post it in #partnerships.
Anya: Default retention: 365 days for redacted marketplace artifacts — ok?
Samira: Legal ok with 365 days for redacted artifacts. Originals must live in secure vault for longer (we recommend 7 years).
Jorge: We'll keep originals in internal vault; only redacted versions go to marketplace.
Ken: I will include a contact_email column so partners can be looped for renewals and re-scans.
Samira: Draft attestation uploaded to internal drive: https://drive.redwood.com/s/attestation-draft (internal access)
Jorge: Scan exports uploaded to internal vault: s3://redwood-compliance/acme/pen-test-2026/scan-exports.zip
Anya: Next sync scheduled: Monday 2026-03-22 10:00 PT. Invite sent. Please surface blockers before then. :thumbsup:
Ken: I'll post the checklist in ~30m with the CSV template and example presign command.
Samira: Noted, will review the checklist when posted.
Jorge: If we need hardware photos for redaction guidance, I'll request from EdgeHW.
Anya: Thanks all — closing loop for now.
